notes: v5 signal pilot on AgentClinic-MedQA: collaborative diagnosis where the Consultant Agent holds examination and test evidence the Doctor has not seen. Two collaboration turns (D1-A1, D2-A2), then the Doctor's final diagnosis; A1 is the intervention point. Rollouts here are offline continuations for labels (K = 9), not GRPO rollouts; no Effectiveness Model is called or trained by this config.

dataset.selection_notes: eligible = Correct_Diagnosis present, Patient_Actor present, Physical_Examination_Findings and Test_Results non-empty, at least min_test_findings test-result values. Cases whose consultant-only evidence contains the Correct_Diagnosis string are left out of the pool (the consultant would be handed the answer; their ids are recorded in the run manifest for a separate analysis). Pilot cases are a seeded random sample of the TRAIN split. No model output and no outcome is used.

pilot.cases_notes: 32 TRAIN cases; their prepared histories are frozen (histories.frozen.sha256) and every candidate is applied to all of them
pilot.first_label_selection_notes: the first K = 9 run labelled 16 of them (D1 diagnosis != Agent standalone diagnosis, seed 0; pilot_label_cases.json); the remaining 16 were added afterwards

candidates.notes: a candidate that does not comply is generated again, up to max_attempts; every generation is kept in candidate_attempts.jsonl. evidence_only_report is a diagnostic candidate outside the behavior classes.
